#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
fail=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    if ! grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*permissions:' "$file"; then
        echo "Workflow file $file missing permissions:" >&2
        fail=1
    fi
done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi
